source_title: DDBC Time Authority Database, Chinese calendar, February 2012
attribution: Chinese calendar data assembled by the Library and Information Center of Dharma Drum Buddhist College, 2008–2010; public archive published February 2012.
license: CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported, per archive README.txt and COPYING.txt
western_calendar: proleptic Gregorian (extended Gregorian for dates before 1582); year numbering is positive CE in this scope
conversion: Gregorian date = 0001-01-01 + (JDN - 1721426) days; only integer CE years are entered, no inferred exact dates. Adjacent records split at political reign transitions are unioned for the original month.
limitations: Calendar lookup supports date conversion only, not the identity or historicity of an action. Primary event evidence remains the selected Ming History EPUB/TXT. Source variants remain distinct.
